Metropolitan Area Planning Council
44 School Street Boston, Massachusetts 02108
Carla B. Johnston Executive Director
(617) 523-2454
July 29, 1977
Mr. Marvin Siflinger Acting Area Office Director Department of Housing and Urban Development 15 New Chardon Street Boston, MA. 02114
Attention: Environmental Clearance Officer
RE: Draft Environmental Impact Statement Kendall Square Urban Renewal Project Cambridge, Massachusetts
HUD Project No. R-108
(MAPC # E1R-77-10; Received 6/24/77)
Dear Mr. Siflinger:
In accordance with the U.S. Office of Management and Budget Circular A-95, as amended, the Metropolitan Area Planning Council has reviewed the above referenced draft environmental impact statement. We find the proposed urban renewal project, as presented and analyzed therein, to be consistent with regional goals and objectives.
Very truly yours,
Carla B. Johnston
Executive Director
cc: Harold Thompson, HUD-Acting Regional Administrator Robert Paquin, HUD- Boston Area Office Maurine Hynes, State Clearinghouse- OSP Richard Easler, MAPC Representative, Cambridge
AUG 2 - 1977
